summary: Advance one ingestion from a named stage through the remaining pipeline.

input_schema.ingestion_id: string | The ingestion identifier to advance.
input_schema.from_stage: string | The first stage to consider: store, extract, normalize, or anchor.
input_schema.force_target: boolean | optional | Re-run the requested target stage even if its latest run succeeded.

output_schema.status: string | The current ingestion lifecycle status.
output_schema.source_uri: string | null | The original source URI, if any.
output_schema.source_actor: string | null | The originating actor, if any.
output_schema.mime_type: string | null | The source MIME type, if any.
output_schema.last_error: string | null | The most recent ingestion error, if any.
